music_release.headline: Your plan for a music release
music_release.body: Your track works best when people hear it many times, in many places, in a short window. Your guide shows how clips get the release onto feeds, where to post first, and what counts as a view.

podcast_stream.headline: Your plan for a podcast or stream
podcast_stream.body: Long shows are full of short moments. Your guide shows how clips turn those moments into reasons to watch the full thing, where to post first, and what counts as a view.
